title: In Vitro Activity of a Novel Diaminopyrimidine Compound, Iclaprim, against Chlamydia trachomatis and C. pneumoniae
abstract: ABSTRACT                        The in vitro activities of iclaprim, a novel dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor, azithromycin, and levofloxacin were tested against 10 strains of             Chlamydia trachomatis             and 10 isolates of             Chlamydia pneumoniae             . For             C. trachomatis             and             C. pneumoniae             , the iclaprim MIC and minimal bactericidal concentration at which 90% of isolates were inhibited (MIC             90             and MBC             90             ) were 0.5 μg/ml, compared to an azithromycin MIC             90             and MBC             90             of 0.125 μg/ml and levofloxacin MIC             90             s and MBC             90             s of 1 μg/ml for             C. trachomatis             and 0.5 μg/ml for             C. pneumoniae             .
